subject: Hosted evaluation — deployment preference & quickstart asks
messages:
From: Rafael Mendes <rafael.mendes@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@clearsend.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted evaluation — deployment preference & quickstart asks

Hi Emily —

Great to meet today, thanks for walking us through the ClearSend use case. Quick recap and concrete next steps so we stay aligned while you evaluate deployment fit:

1) Short recap of your requirements (from our call)
- Primary goal: integrate LLM summarization into the agent inbox to cut handle time by ~30%
- Latency target: p95 generation < 250ms for 512-token prompts
- Expected steady-state: ~80 QPS; expected peak bursts up to ~450 QPS during send windows
- Data residency: US only; logs retained 30 days
- Security: SOC 2 required; customer-managed KMS is a nice-to-have but not required for the pilot

2) Deployment mode inclination
You said you prefer the fastest path to production and minimal ops overhead for the pilot — that points towards Hosted API as the recommended on-ramp. Dedicated capacity or Private VPC would make sense later if you need guaranteed throughput or stricter KMS/HSM controls.

3) Hosted quickstart we can provide
- Sandbox token & staging endpoint (short-lived): included
- Pre-configured endpoint with a 50 QPS baseline for the sandbox; we can scale slices up to 300 QPS for demo windows
- Suggested rate plan for pilot: start with 100 QPS sustained, burst to 450 QPS for short windows (we'll provision a traffic slice and monitor)

4) Asks from your side (what we need to provision fast)
- Confirm whether the 30-day log retention is acceptable for the pilot or whether you need shorter/longer windows
- Expected average payload size (tokens in + out) and expected percent of requests that will call the summarization tool vs full generation
- Any regulatory constraints beyond SOC 2 (e.g., PCI, HIPAA) that would push you toward Private

5) Next steps & timeline
- We can spin up a sandbox endpoint tomorrow once you share the attached worksheet with traffic patterns filled in (clearsend_quickstart_requirements.xlsx)
- I’ll drop the sandbox instructions PDF and a short runbook for rate-slicing (redwood_sandbox_instructions.pdf)
- Proposed sync: 30-min technical preflight after you fill the worksheet — available Fri 3/23 at 10am PT or Mon 3/26 at 9am PT

If Hosted looks good for the pilot we’ll keep the footprint small and set clear gates for when to evaluate Dedicated/Private (traffic thresholds, KMS needs, SLA requirements).

Thanks — looking forward to the worksheet.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
r.mendes@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--
Attachment stubs: clearsend_quickstart_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet), redwood_sandbox_instructions.pdf (PDF)

Date: Wed, 21 Mar 2028 13:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Hosted evaluation — deployment preference & quickstart asks

Thanks Rafael — this is perfect and very actionable. Quick answers inline: 
- 30-day log retention is fine for the pilot.
- Avg payloads: ~250 tokens in, ~120 tokens out on average; summarization will be ~70% of calls.
- Regulatory: no HIPAA/PCI for this project; SOC 2 will suffice for now.

We’ll fill the worksheet and target the Fri 3/23 10am PT slot. Can you confirm whether the sandbox token will be scoped so it can hit the staged summarization endpoint only? We want to avoid accidental writes to prod-like systems.

—Emily
Emily Park

Hi Emily,

Confirmed — sandbox tokens are scoped to the staging endpoint only and we’ll set ACLs to prevent any access to production routes. I’ll include a short token usage matrix in the instructions that outlines scope, expiration, and rate limits.

I’m also adding a recommended initial config for your traffic profile based on the numbers Rafael captured:
- Staging endpoint: 50 QPS baseline; allow 300 QPS burst slice for demo windows
- Token TTL: 7 days for sandbox tokens; let us know if you want a shorter TTL
- Monitoring: we’ll add a per-endpoint dashboard and set an alert at 80% of provisioned slice capacity

I’ll upload the token and the ACL config to the sandbox link once you send the worksheet.

—Soojin
